messages:
marta: Heads-up — partner 'acme-webhooks' logs contain a KMS-wrapped blob and the partner SA in plaintext. Looks like our ingestion pipeline failed to redact the wrapped_blob field. Need a rapid sweep + rotations.

james: Ack. Can you paste an example log line? Is it ciphertext or base64-wrapped blob?

marta: sample log: `partner_sa: prod-acme@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com wrapped_blob: CiQAx...==` — base64 blob present in clear.

lee: tagging sec + infra — @sanjay @irene we should treat this as a credential exposure. Immediate steps: block ingestion, snapshot + quarantine logs, enumerate impacted ciphertexts, and plan rewrap/rotate.

sanjay: On it — pushing an ingest-gw filter to drop requests from partner origin and IP range. ETA ~6m. Also enabling audit logs for the partner-logs bucket.

irene: On Vault/KMS side: we should rotate the wrapping key (create wrap-key-v2) and rewrap affected ciphertexts to the new key. Need the list of object ids (or log offsets) to target.

james: How many hits are we talking about? Need to size the rewrap job.

marta: Quick grep on 2026-03-20 logs showed ~120 occurrences across three buckets. I uploaded an access-restricted list to a private gist: <https://internal.gist/priv/rewrap-list-xxxxx> (only accessible to sec & infra).

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0331 — triage: credential-exposure. Severity: S2. Playbook: secrets-management -> credential-rotation linked.

lee: Converging plan:
- sanjay: block ingestion and create quarantine bucket
- james: snapshot + inventory logs -> produce quarantine-list.txt
- irene: create wrap-key-v2, run targeted rewrap job
- marta: RBAC lockdown for partner key + coordinate partner comms
- oncall-eng: create ephemeral token flow for rewrap-runner and enable audit forwarding to SIEM
- everyone: retain copies in quarantine for 7d per legal

marta: I'll own RBAC and partner comms. Specific RBAC actions I propose now: remove any non-service accounts from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the partner wrapping key, create a short-lived 'partner-impersonator' role for the rewrap-runner with 1 hour bindings, and revoke long-lived credentials.

james: For rewrap dry-run, I'll use the rewrap worker in dry-run mode first. Example command I'll run:```gcloud kms keys versions create-rotation --location=global --keyring=partner-ring --key=wrap-key --purpose=encryption``` (dry-run via `--validate-only`) then call our rewrap script:```python tools/rewrap.py --input-list=quarantine-list.txt --from-key=wrap-key-v1 --to-key=wrap-key-v2 --dry-run```

sanjay: Ingestion blocked. filter id: fw-2026-acme-block. Quarantine bucket created: gs://quarantine-acme-20260320. ACLs restricted to sec+infra.

irene: Starting targeted rewrap (dry-run). Job command:```python tools/rewrap.py --input-list=quarantine-list.txt --from-key=wrap-key-v1 --to-key=wrap-key-v2 --mode=dry-run --concurrency=10``` Posting progress every 5m.

marta: RBAC change applied: removed the partner org dev group from decrypt role on the wrap key, added binding for partner-impersonator with max duration 1h scoped to the rewrap-runner service account. Will open PR for the IAM delta.

lee: Post-incident action items (to capture for postmortem): auto-redact fields matching `/(wrapped|cipher|kms|ciphertext)_blob/` in logging pipeline, add unit tests for logging redactors, add a pre-commit linter that flags high-entropy strings in logs, and ensure KMS audit logs are exported to SIEM within 15m.

james: Once dry-run looks good, we'll run rewrap for real. After rewrap, rotate Vault transit keys and issue ephemeral tokens for any downstream services that need decrypt access.

oncall-eng: Creating ephemeral token flow via workload identity for rewrap-runner and a short-lived policy for decryption. ETA ~45m. Enabling Cloud Audit Logs export to SIEM now.

marta: I'll draft the partner/customer notification and timeline in #support-escalations. Also filing a follow-up for legal/compliance to review quarantine retention. Thanks everyone — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
